summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for fever, cough, and shortness of breath, with lab evidence of infection and clinical signs of sepsis. She was treated for suspected bacterial pneumonia and COPD exacerbation, receiving IV antibiotics and a steroid taper. Her symptoms improved rapidly, with normalization of white blood cell count and stable oxygenation. She was discharged home on oral antibiotics, a prednisone taper, and her baseline medications, with instructions to monitor weight and symptoms. Blood cultures remained pending at discharge, and follow-up was arranged for INR monitoring and leg assessment.
